history.summary: Twin shrines at Mandrem village, Pernem taluka, North Goa — Sapteshwar (a Shiva shrine) and the Devi Bhagavati temple (eight-armed, Ashtabhuja, form of the Goddess on a high pedestal). The 7-day Bhajanisaptah in the month of Kartika is the principal festival, with Jatra, Dussehra and Shimgo also drawing large crowds; exquisitely sculptured ancillary deities surround the main temples. GTDC's listing conflates this Mandrem complex with the separate Shri Bhagavati complex at Parshem (7 km from Pernem, with five shrines and two deepstambhas) — keep the two distinct. TOWN NOTE: CSV says 'Pernem'; the temple is at Mandrem in Pernem taluka, not far from Morjim. Coordinates corroborated by geocoding and an independent place listing (15.661605, 73.735869).

name: Shri Sapteshwar Bhagavati Temple
town_description: Mandrem is a coastal village in Pernem taluka, North Goa, known for Mandrem beach on the Arabian Sea. It lies a few kilometres north of Morjim and about 21 km from Panaji.

travel.railway: Pernem Railway Station (7.8 km per local listing)
travel.road: Mandrem Road, Mandrem, Pernem taluka; ~5.8 km from Pernem bus stand; near Morjim.
